title: Which drawn thing is which material for the light
text: Materials.json has no entry for a character, so the light layer reads the human, the Codex and Clawd as `body` (albedo 0.3, stipple-2) and the box, the gadget and the kit's pieces as `box` (albedo 0.15, stipple-2); the human's cloak and hair are not told apart from her body yet (the parts rig draws one canvas), so the hair's soft stipple-1 and the cloth's albedo 0.25 do not show. The bubble is `glass` (transmissive) and is not in the occluder mask. A per-part split of the human, or a `cast` material for Clawd and Codex, would change what casts and what bounces. (The other half of this proposal, the shot palette the eye-trace fills lacked, was ruled a measurement fix and is done: v3/roles.json now carries s01Turrell, the box's tape and the title lockup.)

before.note: roles.json lists the settled palette only; characters have no material

after.note: decide: a cast material for Clawd and the Codex, and whether the human is split per part (hair, cloth, body)
